resources.string: Polarka\'s faucet sends a small amount to the address above, once a day at most. The phone first does some work for it: usually seconds, at most a few minutes. The faucet learns this address and the internet address of this phone.
The faucet says it sent it. The coin shows in the balance once it is in a block, usually within a few minutes. The faucet\'s transaction:
The faucet said no (%1$s). Try again later.
The faucet cannot pay just now (NOT_NOW). If you asked a moment ago, its payment may still be on its way: do not ask again for this address today.
The faucet did not answer in time. Try again later.
The faucet cannot be reached. Try again later.
The faucet sent an answer that this app cannot read.
The faucet asks for more work than this app does.
The faucet\'s challenge ran out before the work was done. If this happens every time, check the date and time of this phone.
No answer to the faucet\'s challenge was found. Try again.
